key_insight: TryOnCrafter introduces camera-controllable video virtual try-on, letting users explore garment fit and appearance from new viewpoints instead of being limited to the original camera path. It does this by building a renderable 4D try-on proxy that supports realistic viewpoint changes in dynamic video.
problem_solved: Existing video virtual try-on methods depend on the source video’s camera trajectory, which prevents interactive, omnidirectional viewpoint exploration. This paper addresses the lack of camera control in realistic try-on synthesis.
method: Defines a new setting called Camera-controllable Video Virtual Try-on (CaM-VVT) for interactive viewpoint control.
Constructs a renderable 4D try-on proxy to represent clothing and motion across space and time.
Uses the proxy to synthesize realistic try-on results from novel camera trajectories while preserving garment fidelity and motion consistency.
impact: This is useful for AI/ML practitioners working on generative video, 3D-aware synthesis, fashion tech, and interactive content creation. It moves virtual try-on from passive playback toward controllable, user-driven visualization.

paper_title: TryOnCrafter: Unleashing Camera Trajectories for Realistic Video Virtual Try-on via a Renderable 4D Try-on Proxy
paper_authors: Hao Sun, Hao Yan, Mengting Chen, Quanjian Song, Yu Li
